_readme: QUEENSTOWN FIXED-PRICE MENU. These are researched prices, not placeholders.
Where they came from: Queenstown call-out plus first-hour rates as advertised in November 2026 (DECISIONS.md).

New trades and their jobs added 24 November 2026 (DECISIONS.md, 2026-11-24): each such item says where its price came from in 'source'. Items whose price has no Queenstown figure behind it carry needsLocalQuote and load switched off.

Fixed prices by size, not hours (DECISIONS.md, 2026-11-24, second entry): window cleaning by storeys and bedrooms, lawns by area, hedges by length, garden tidy in 1- and 2-hour blocks, and one-room cleans, each a visit on its own with the cleaner's travel and minimum in the price. A job holds one menu item, so common pairs (bedroom and bathroom) are items of their own.
This file only fills an EMPTY database, the first time the site is deployed. After that, change prices on the admin screen: More > Markets, prices and the menu.
Prices are in whole dollars and include GST.
ownerPriceDollars is what the owner's card is charged. tradiePayoutDollars is what the tradie receives.
The gap is what the platform keeps: a 15% fee on the owner price. Every owner price is payout / 0.85 rounded to the nearest $5.
licenceRequired is true for any plumbing, gas, electrical or drainlaying work. Builder jobs also need an LBP number on file (config/trades.ts).
needsLocalQuote: the price came from national averages, not a Queenstown quote. These load SWITCHED OFF. Ring a local, fix the price, then tick 'On the menu' on the admin screen.
isAddOn: only makes sense alongside another job on the same visit. These load SWITCHED OFF, because the app cannot attach an add-on to a job yet.
guestVisible false: a job the owner arranges. Guests do not see it on the QR code form.
seasonal and tags are notes for people. Nothing in the app reads them yet.

items.description: Bulbs you can twist, push or screw out (including GU10 downlight bulbs and tubes), up to 5. Not for a sealed LED downlight with no bulb to take out, or a light that still won't work with a new bulb: book "Light not working, not sure why" (an electrician) instead.
items.tryFirst: Check the bulb is in firmly and the switch is on. If the whole light is one sealed unit with no bulb to take out, book "Light not working, not sure why".
items.notes: Bulbs only. Replacing a light fitting is prescribed electrical work in NZ: that is EL-06, electricians only. A sealed LED downlight, or a light still dead with a new bulb: don't touch it, tap Not the job described.

items.name: Paint touch-ups, up to 2 hours
items.source: Priced in step with HM-13 patch and paint (NZ$235). Queenstown painter wages NZ$35-40 an hour (job ads, 2026). Paint is a part.

items.name: Repaint one wall or one ceiling, up to 15 square metres
items.source: Priced in step with HM-13 patch and paint: about 3.5 hours. Paint is a part.

items.name: Repaint one door and frame, or one window frame
items.source: Priced in step with HM-13 patch and paint: about 2.5 hours. Paint is a part.

items.name: Ant or spider treatment, inside and out
items.source: No Queenstown pest firm publishes a price (Rentokil NZ prices after an inspection). Moneyhub Wellington: ant control NZ$150+. Ring a local before switching on.

items.name: Wasp nest removal
items.source: Moneyhub Wellington: one-off wasp nest control NZ$100-175. No Queenstown price found. Ring a local before switching on.

items.name: Rats or mice: baiting and entry check, first visit
items.source: No NZ published price found. Priced from the Queenstown labour band, about 1.5 hours plus bait stations. Ring a local before switching on.

items.name: Septic or wastewater system fault, call-out and first hour
items.source: A Bay of Plenty septic specialist suggested NZ$200 for a fault call-out including the first hour (founder, Nov 2026); Queenstown plumbing call-out and first hour NZ$207-322 incl. GST (DECISIONS.md, 2026-11-16).

items.name: Aerated wastewater system service
items.source: A Bay of Plenty septic specialist suggested NZ$400 for a routine aerated-system service (founder, Nov 2026). No Queenstown price published (DrainPro Central Otago asks for a quote). Ring a local before switching on.

items.name: Septic tank pump-out, standard household tank
items.source: No NZ price published (Central Otago operators quote, with an establishment fee). Queensland guide (The Quote Yard): AU$350-750 a standard pump-out. Ring a local before switching on.

items.name: Blocked outside drain or gully trap cleared
items.source: In step with PL-08 blocked drain (NZ$245) at the Queenstown plumbing rate; outside drains often need a drain machine.
